department: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India
benefit: For your first child you get Rs 5,000 in two parts: Rs 3,000 after you register the pregnancy and have one check-up, and Rs 2,000 after the birth is registered and the baby gets the vaccines due up to 14 weeks. If your second child is a girl, you get Rs 6,000 in one part.

other: You are pregnant or a new mother.

You belong to a listed group, such as SC or ST women, women with a BPL or NFSA ration card, e-Shram card, MGNREGA job card, PM-JAY card, PM-Kisan women farmers, disabled women, or family income below Rs 8 lakh a year.
Women in regular government or PSU jobs, or who get paid maternity leave, cannot get it.
Apply within 270 days of the child's birth.

documents: Bank or post office account linked to Aadhaar
Proof that you are eligible (for example ration card or e-Shram card)
how_to_apply: Register on the PMMVY website or mobile app. Choose first child or second child, fill your details and submit. In Tamil Nadu the scheme is run through the Public Health department.
where_to_apply: Online on the PMMVY website or app, or at the Anganwadi centre or approved health facility.

gaps: The myScheme page gives two different time limits (270 days from birth in eligibility, and 2 years from LMP in the FAQ). The shorter one is used.
The helpline number is a Delhi government office listed on myScheme, not a Tamil Nadu number.
The pages do not say how PMMVY combines with Tamil Nadu's own Dr Muthulakshmi Reddy maternity scheme.

review.note: The page has internal conflicts on deadlines, and in Tamil Nadu it may be paid together with the state maternity scheme, which the pages do not explain.
